title: nigritella angustifolia
intro: Nigritella angustifolia, commonly known as the Yellow or Broad-leaved Fly Orchid, is a type of flowering plant in the orchid family. This plant has been found to possess various health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Nigritella angustifolia include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve respiratory issues such as coughs and bronchitis, as well as its potential to lower blood pressure and improve cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
